teaser.en: A doum palm in miniature, it often grows with no trunk at all, its fan leaves rising straight from the sand.
teaser.sw: Ni mkoma mdogo kabisa; mara nyingi hukua bila shina hata kidogo, na majani yake ya umbo la pepeo huchipuka moja kwa moja kutoka mchangani.
teaser.dg: Ni dza mkoma mdide sana, na mara nyinji tachina kolo kabisa: makodzage dza chiphephero ganamera chocho kula mtsangani.

summary.en: *Chikoko*, the lala or dwarf doum palm, is a small fan palm that grows in colonies on coastal sands near the sea. Like its larger cousin the doum palm, its leaves are woven and its small fruits are eaten.
summary.sw: *Chikoko*, au mkoma wa pwani, ni mmea mdogo wa jamii ya mnazi wenye majani ya umbo la pepeo unaokua kwa makundi kwenye mchanga wa pwani karibu na bahari. Kama ndugu yake mkubwa, mkoma, majani yake husukwa na matunda yake madogo huliwa.
summary.dg: *Chikoko* ni mkoma mdide wa pwani (*lala palm* au *dwarf doum palm* kpwa Chingereza), wenye makodza dza chiphephero, unaomera kpwa makundi kpwenye mtsanga wa pwani phephi na bahari. Dza mkoma, nduguye mkulu, makodza ga chikoko nkusukwa na matundage madide nkuriwa.

about.en:
*Chikoko* is a small palm, often with no trunk to speak of, or with short, leaning trunks of 3 to 4 metres. Its leaves are stiff fans, grey-green, curving down at the tips, on stalks lined with hooked spines.

Its fruits are small and gourd-shaped, with a hard, shiny brown skin over a fibrous pulp and a very hard kernel, like a smaller version of the doum palm's fruit.
about.sw:
*Chikoko* ni mmea mdogo wa jamii ya mnazi, mara nyingi bila shina la kutajwa, au wenye mashina mafupi yaliyoinama ya mita 3 hadi 4. Majani yake ni pepeo ngumu, za rangi ya kijani-kijivu, zinazopinda chini kwenye ncha, juu ya mikono yenye miiba iliyopinda kama ndoano.

Matunda yake ni madogo na yana umbo la kibuyu, yenye ganda gumu la kahawia linalong'aa juu ya nyama yenye nyuzi na kokwa ngumu sana, kama toleo dogo la tunda la mkoma.
about.dg:
*Chikoko* ni mkoma mdide; mara nyinji tachina kolo kabisa, au chikala na makolo mafupi ganayodeguka ga mita 3 hadi 4. Makodzage ni magumu dza chiphephero, ga rangi ya chijani na ivu, ganainama photsi kpwenye ntsa zago, kpwenye milita yenye miya ya kupindika.

Matundage ni madide na ga umbo ra chiburu, na gada gumu rinaroala ra rangi ya dongo, nyama ya nyuzi-nyuzi ndani, na chitsa chigumu sana, dza tunda ra mkoma, ela dide.

where.en: It grows in small colonies on coastal sands near the sea and in coastal bushland. Clumps of *chikoko* are a common sight in the scrub behind the beach on the south coast.
where.sw: Hukua kwa makundi madogo kwenye mchanga wa pwani karibu na bahari na katika vichaka vya pwani. Makundi ya *chikoko* ni jambo la kawaida kuonekana katika vichaka vilivyo nyuma ya ufuo kwenye pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: *Chikoko* chinamera kpwa makundi madide kpwenye mtsanga wa pwani phephi na bahari na weruni pwani. Makundi ga *chikoko* ni ga kawaida kuonekana weruni nyuma ya mtsanga wa pwani, pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: *Chikoko* is used in much the same way as the doum palm. Its leaves are split and woven, and used for thatch, and its fruit is eaten.
uses.sw: *Chikoko* hutumika kwa namna ile ile kama mkoma. Majani yake hupasuliwa na kusukwa, na hutumika kuezekea, na tunda lake huliwa.
uses.dg: *Chikoko* nkuhumirwa sawa na mkoma. Makodzage nkuahulwa na nkusukwa, na nkuhumirwa kuezeka nyumba, na matundage nkuriwa.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chikoko*. In Swahili it is *mkoma wa pwani*, 'the doum palm of the coast'. The Mgombato dictionary's entry for *mkoma* covers both this dwarf palm and the doum palm. In English it is the lala palm or dwarf doum palm, and its scientific name is *Hyphaene coriacea*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *chikoko*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkoma wa pwani*. Kamusi ya Mgombato, chini ya *mkoma*, inahusu mmea huu mdogo na mkoma wenyewe. Kwa Kiingereza ni *lala palm* au *dwarf doum palm*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Hyphaene coriacea*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *chikoko*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkoma wa pwani*. Mgombato unahumira neno *mkoma* kpwa mkoma uhu mdide na kpwa mkoma mkulu. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lala palm* au *dwarf doum palm*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Hyphaene coriacea*.

definition.en: The leaves of a young fan palm (doum or borassus). The name depends on the palm's age because only young plants' leaves are useful.
definition.sw: Majani ya mmea mchanga wa jamii ya mnazi wenye majani ya pepeo (mkoma au mvumo). Jina hutegemea umri wa mmea kwa sababu ni majani ya mimea michanga tu yanayofaa.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muhi mtsanga wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza dza chiphephero (mkoma au mvumo). Neno hiri ni ra makodza ga mimea midide tu, kpwa sababu ndigo genye kazi.

use.en: Woven into mats, baskets, hats and other items.
use.sw: Husukwa kuwa mikeka, vikapu, kofia na vitu vingine.
use.dg: Nkusukwa kuhenda micheka, vikapu, kofiya na vitu vyanjina.

meaning.en: From an older word meaning 'dwarf palm'. Mgombato glosses mlala as 'raffia', the weaving fibre.
meaning.sw: Kutokana na neno la zamani lenye maana ya 'mnazi mfupi'. Mgombato inalieleza mlala kama 'raffia', nyuzi za kusuka.
meaning.dg: Rinalavywa kula neno ra kare ra 'muhi mdide wa jamii ya mnazi'. Mgombato unaeleza *mlala* kukala 'raffia', nyuzi za kusuka.

shared_with: bangalala: the leaves of the mature palm

definition.en: The leaves of a mature fan palm (doum or borassus), which are not used for weaving.
definition.sw: Majani ya mmea uliokomaa wa jamii ya mnazi wenye majani ya pepeo (mkoma au mvumo), ambayo hayatumiki kwa kusuka.
definition.dg: Makodza ga muhi wa jamii ya mnazi wenye makodza dza chiphephero uriokula (mkoma au mvumo), ambago tagahumirwa kusuka.

shared_with: mlala: the leaves of the young palm

definition.en: The fruit of the doum palm.
A strip of raffia (mlala) about 5 mm wide.
definition.sw: Kipande cha raffia (mlala) chenye upana wa takriban mm 5.
definition.dg: Chipande chembamba cha mlala (raffia), cha mm 5 hivi.

definition.en: Pieces of raffia (mlala) ready for weaving. The Swahili gloss, minyaa, refers to strips of doum palm leaf.
definition.sw: Vipande vya raffia (mlala) vilivyo tayari kusukwa. Maana ya Kiswahili, minyaa, inahusu vipande vya majani ya mkoma.
definition.dg: Vipande vya mlala virivyo tayari kusukwa. Neno ra Chiswahili, *minyaa*, rinamaanisha vipande vya makodza ga mkoma.

definition.en: The hard edges of raffia (mlala) leaves, made into very fine thread for sewing plaits together into a mat or basket.
definition.sw: Kingo ngumu za majani ya raffia (mlala), zinazotengenezwa kuwa uzi mwembamba sana wa kushonea visuko pamoja kuwa mkeka au kikapu.
definition.dg: Kanda ngumu za makodza ga mlala, zinazohendwa uzi mwembamba sana wa kushona vipande virivyosukwa kuhenda mcheka au chikapu.
